meta.name: invoice_chain
meta.model: core model of theory_core.tex; engine configuration reliability.enabled = false
not_modeled: tax wedges and effective wages (the engine choice-cost view); the example uses pre-tax cash costs

calendar dynamics (inference price decline, capability growth); the example is static at the capability date t0, and the build-cost decline delta_F enters only the rebuilds of the engine-horizon program
the failure taxonomy in mode choice (hallucination, complacency, autonomy); Section sec:tasks-failure examples apply it to the approval step separately
control costs of the failure taxonomy (monitoring, least privilege, kill switch) and the ICFR control-cost change (accounting theorist)
the success-logit penalties that require the failure taxonomy (a_fm) and the pipeline driver (a_J)

illustration.rule: detection at the top of its measured range; every target capped at min(r_bar_high, q*), where r_bar_high is the human-parity target and q* the highest level, rounded down to 0.1 point, that every step can meet at the high readiness target; the cap never raises a target

volume.basis: supplier invoices a year; at the P02 procure-to-pay prior of 100 invoices per $1M of revenue (data/tasks/processes.csv, assumed) this is a firm with $1.2 billion of revenue

function.basis: accounts payable sits in finance and accounting (engine function prior finance_accounting; params outsourcing key F11)

exposure.basis: engine fallback LLM exposure when no activity data (impute.py) and the reference exposure of augment.exposure_ref

data_class.basis: engine fallback for a function without personal data (impute.py); finance_accounting personal_data = 0

external_inputs.basis: engine fallback for a function that is not customer facing

iota_prior.basis: engine prior of today's readiness in finance (reported, not used as case a)

iota_low.basis: case (a), a low-readiness firm (coordinator decision, 29 Oct)

iota_high.basis: highest readiness target of the engine

capability_date.basis: the example is static at the date of the horizon fit

r.basis: continuous rate ln(1 + annual WACC); the engine default applies transform to_continuous to the params value

T_h.basis: useful life of internal-use software (ASC 350-40 practice, 3 to 5 years); coordinator decision of 29 Oct

T_h_engine.basis: engine planning horizon: a program in which the builds are redone every T_A years (plans.py rebuilds)

delta_F.basis: annual decline of build cost; a rebuild k T_A years out costs F_build (1 - delta_F)^(k T_A) (plans.py)

d_R.basis: reviewer catch rate of ordinary errors

ai_engineer_wage.basis: w^SE of prop:labor-talent(a): OEWS May 2025 median for SOC 15-1252 Software Developers (data/tasks/occupations.csv); replaces the hard-coded engine fallback of 133,080

process_owner_wage.basis: engine role wage (economics.role_rates default for process_owner)

risk_governance_wage.basis: engine role wage (economics.role_rates default for risk_governance, times 1.2)

survivor_excess_quits.basis: eta_0 T_s: excess quits per announced wave, share of survivors

survivor_quits_per_share.basis: eta_1 T_s: excess quits per unit of displacement share (enters C^surv)

delta_eff.basis: delta_0: announcement productivity loss of survivors (enters O_s)

regulated_capture.basis: accounts payable is a financial-reporting process in scope for SOX ICFR at a public company; regulated status is a property of the process and its data class, not of the firm's error tolerance, so it holds in the conditional case with the relaxed target (coordinator decision of 29 Oct; replaces the engine rule regulated iff target >= 0.99)

gwa_match.basis: O*NET GWA Processing Information (reconcile records); P02 step 5 uses DWA 4.A.2.a.2.d.1

regulated_match.basis: accounts payable is a financial-reporting process in scope for SOX ICFR at a public company; regulated status is a property of the process and its data class, not of the firm's error tolerance, so it holds in the conditional case with the relaxed target (coordinator decision of 29 Oct; replaces the engine rule regulated iff target >= 0.99)

gwa_exceptions.basis: O*NET GWA Making Decisions and Solving Problems

regulated_exceptions.basis: resolving three-way-match exceptions changes recorded liabilities, so it is a key ICFR activity in accounts payable; regulated status is a property of the process, not of the target (coordinator decision of 29 Oct)

gwa_approval.basis: O*NET GWA Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

regulated_approval.basis: accounts payable is a financial-reporting process in scope for SOX ICFR at a public company; regulated status is a property of the process and its data class, not of the firm's error tolerance, so it holds in the conditional case with the relaxed target (coordinator decision of 29 Oct; replaces the engine rule regulated iff target >= 0.99)
